ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white fields dominate the center of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the leading and trailing edges, with dense, feather-like mottling originating from the peduncle and extending into the white central fields. Scattered linear black markings are distributed across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the primary trailing edge, with increased pixel-level irregularity and jaggedness localized near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning to sharp, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels (barnacles) concentrated on the furthest distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned dark linear pixel tracks (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields, oriented primarily in a diagonal-longitudinal direction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) across both lobes and active barnacle colonization on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast black 'brush-stroke' pigmentation pattern radiating outward from the central notch area.
